statements.t: Chris Layden, chief executive officer, said, “In the third quarter, we delivered results above the midpoint of our guidance, driven by meaningful progress on our growth and efficiency initiatives along with increasingly constructive demand trends.

The Company’s financial outlook assumes no material change in the macroeconomic environment relative to the third quarter, and is consistent with the full year expectations set in February of this year.
The presentation and a link to the live webcast will be accessible through the Company’s public website on the Investor Relations page under Events & Presentations.
We expect to meet our ongoing short-term and long-term cash requirements principally through cash generated from operations, available cash and equivalents and our credit facilities.
We expect our working capital requirements to increase if demand for our services increases.
We periodically review our foreign subsidiaries’ cash balances and projected cash needs.

We expect our international cash will be needed to fund working capital growth in our local operations as working capital needs, primarily trade accounts receivable, increase during periods of growth.
